title: Indonesia's national passport database leak
description: We hacked into Imigarasi's internal network and obtained information on over 90 million passports, as well as fingerprint data and biometric information. Feel free to follow us; we will consider selling the data rather than just releasing it randomly.If major security agencies suspect that our data is just for show, like questioning its authenticity, you can add me on our session, and I’ll prove it to you. Especially checkpoint, I noticed you’ve been quite rude to our organization, and I’ll prove it to you.
